snippet.title: Kanji Wars Video
snippet.description:
Welcome to Kanji Wars! The fun game where the end result is levelling up your language, not just your character! 

Interact with the fun little "polyblots" to learn the "ABCs" of Japanese (and indeed later any other language in the world!). Never get bored with our cute graphics and gameplay, and our intelligent "Spaced Repetition Systems" that know exactly when to review your progress.
